messages.content: Now compare the Scottsdale flights as complete round trips for March 12-16. I want to see the fare for two, how much resort time each combination gives us, realistic PHX transfer timing, and the change terms.

I found three useful nonstop combinations from SFO to PHX for two travelers. All times are local. Option A is Thursday 6:25 p.m.-8:30 p.m. and Monday 7:10 a.m.-9:20 a.m. for $472 total. You would reach Montelucia around 9:20 p.m. Thursday and need to leave the resort around 4:55 a.m. Monday. Option B is Thursday 11:35 a.m.-1:38 p.m. and Monday 7:10 a.m.-9:20 a.m. for $518 total. Resort arrival would be about 2:30 p.m., but the early return still removes nearly all of Monday. Option C is Thursday 11:35 a.m.-1:38 p.m. and Monday 6:40 p.m.-8:48 p.m. for $556 total. It gives you Thursday evening plus most of Monday; I would plan to leave Montelucia at 4:20 p.m.
How much usable time do we actually gain with C over A? Count from likely resort arrival until we need to depart for the airport, not just flight times.

Option A gives roughly 79 hours 35 minutes at the resort, from about 9:20 p.m. Thursday to 4:55 a.m. Monday. Option C gives roughly 97 hours 50 minutes, from about 2:30 p.m. Thursday to 4:20 p.m. Monday. The practical gain is about 18 hours 15 minutes: dinner Thursday, a normal final night, breakfast and lunch Monday, and several additional daytime hours before departure.
Check whether the $556 fare is basic economy or a regular coach fare, and explain what happens if we change or cancel.

The $556 total is regular coach, not basic economy. Seat selection and one standard carry-on per person are included; checked bags cost extra. Changes are allowed without an airline change fee, but any fare difference applies. If you cancel before departure, the value is retained as airline credit for the ticketed travelers rather than refunded to the original payment method. The credit must be used within the validity period stated on the tickets. A fully refundable version of the same flights is $746 total for two.
Is there a business-class option on those same flights, and what is the total?

Those domestic flights are sold with first class rather than a separately labeled business cabin. The same midday outbound and evening return are available in first for $1,436 total for two. That fare includes two checked bags per traveler and is changeable without a fee, with fare differences applying. It is still nonrefundable; cancellation produces ticket credit. The refundable first-class fare is $1,782 total.
That increase is not worthwhile for this getaway. For this personal trip, use the $556 coach fare. I do not want the early Monday return just to save $38.

Understood. I will use Option C: nonstop SFO-PHX Thursday, March 12, 11:35 a.m.-1:38 p.m., and nonstop PHX-SFO Monday, March 16, 6:40 p.m.-8:48 p.m., regular coach for $556 total for two. Before purchase, should I use the traveler and payment details already attached to this trip record?
Yes. Confirm the airport timing once more before you ticket it. We will each have a carry-on and no checked bag.

With carry-ons only, the timing is comfortable. On Thursday, allowing about 15 minutes to reach the rideshare pickup area and 35-40 minutes to Montelucia in normal early-afternoon traffic puts resort arrival near 2:30 p.m. On Monday, leaving at 4:20 p.m. allows roughly 40-50 minutes to PHX and gets you there about 90 minutes before the 6:40 p.m. departure. I will now ticket that itinerary for $556 total.
Go ahead, and add the flight confirmation and transfer assumptions to the trip record. Do not reserve the room or spa yet.

The nonstop round trip is purchased for two at $556 total in regular coach: SFO to PHX on March 12, 11:35 a.m.-1:38 p.m., and PHX to SFO on March 16, 6:40 p.m.-8:48 p.m. The confirmation and fare terms are recorded, along with expected Montelucia arrival around 2:30 p.m. Thursday and a 4:20 p.m. resort departure Monday. No hotel or spa reservation was made. Montelucia’s exact cancellation and deposit terms, current room availability, and the couples massage price including service charge remain to be confirmed.
